		Data Overview
	

We’re excited to introduce Nemotron-CC-Math - a large-scale, high-quality math corpus extracted from Common Crawl which was used in nemotron pre-training. 
This dataset is built to preserve and surface high-value mathematical and code content… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-CC-Math-v1.
